pathSyntax: dot-separated segments; a numeric segment indexes an array; the leaf value is compared with deep JSON equality
factSelector: a fact selects the chain event by spanId when present; otherwise by kind+nodeKey+status (S5 convention). Derived '#trace.*' facts need no selector.
derivedPathSyntax: paths starting with '#trace.' are computed over the whole source before fact lookup: spanCount, kindCount, fetchCount, backendSpanCount, hasFrontend, hasBackend, serviceSpanCount, valuesSpanCount (spans that carry a values array), valueCount (total value items), localValueCount (value items with kind=local), l2FlagSpanCount (spans whose flags contain L2), asyncInheritedSpanCount (spans whose flags contain ASYNC_INHERITED), invocationIndexes, invocationValueCounts (value items per reconcileAmount span ordered by startNs), serviceReturnValues, serviceThreadIds (ordered by startNs), asyncServiceThreadIdsEqual, asyncServiceThreadDiffersFromController, distinctServiceThreadIdCount, controllerThreadId, controllerValuesAbsent, noParamFieldReturnKinds, graphNodeKeyCount
note: S6b async fixture ONLY. This file is deterministic contract shape, NOT runtime evidence: the real async thread ids, the inherited invocation 1/2/3, the 100 -> 0 on the second call and the ASYNC_INHERITED flags must come from demo L2DemoService#reconcileAsync + the javaagent InheritableThreadLocal/ASM E2E (S6B-A). Never cite this directory as proof of runtime async, of @Async/CompletableFuture support, of long-lived pool propagation, of NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO, of loop folding or of L2 overhead (those are S6B-B/C/D). serviceSource.line and every values[].line are illustrative; tests recompute the init/assign lines from L2DemoService.java.

runtimeProbeExpectations.pool: per-request Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1) created inside the request thread; the single worker is constructed on the first submit, i.e. after the controller frame is open
runtimeProbeExpectations.whySingleWorker: a fixed pool of 3 threads would give every call invocation=1 (each worker has its own copy of childCallCounts); the single worker runs the three tasks sequentially so invocation stays 1/2/3
runtimeProbeExpectations.inheritance: InheritableThreadLocal childValue deep-copies every frame (immutable ids/trace/root/parent/confidence/kind/startNs preserved; values/extraFlags/l2Previous/l2Values/childCallCounts copied into independent collections)
runtimeProbeExpectations.threadIds: all three service spans share one worker thread id different from the controller thread id; ASYNC_INHERITED is appended only when currentThread.id != parent.originThreadId
runtimeProbeExpectations.log: l2_probes_installed method=reconcileAmount offsets=<init>,<assign> lines=<init>,<assign>; l2_probe_missing / l2_no_lvt must be absent
runtimeProbeExpectations.limitations: creation-time inheritance only: long-lived pools / already existing threads have no request context (l2_no_parent, no fabricated span) and reused workers may carry a stale trace; @Async/CompletableFuture/framework continuations are NOT supported

chain.flagsRuntimeAssertion: runtime flags may append advisory flags (DROP_COUNT=<n>, S3_RUNTIME_SDK); assert includes('L2') && includes('ASYNC_INHERITED') on every async reconcileAmount span, absence of L1 / LOST_BACKEND / VALUES_CAPPED / VALUES_TOTAL / NO_DEBUG_INFO, and never deep-equal these arrays
chain.valueKeyOrderNote: array order is contractual (probe execution order); key order inside each value item and inside the event object is NOT contractual, compare by JSON semantics

facts.summary: reconcileAsync 内一次请求恰 3 个 reconcileAmount service span（同 controller 下）
单 worker 顺序执行：invocation 仍按 startNs 为 1/2/3（父 controller 帧副本内计数；固定 3 线程会各得 1）
3 个 service span 的 thread.id 相同（同一 per-request worker）
异步 worker 的 thread.id ≠ controller thread.id（上下文来自创建时继承，不是同线程执行）
仅 3 个异步 service span 带 ASYNC_INHERITED；click/fetch/controller 不带
3 个 service span 均带 L2；没有 L1/LOST_BACKEND
第 2 次调用第 2 项 to=0，from=100：跨线程继承后坏行 100 → 0 仍被采到
每次调用的首项 from=null（副本帧内 previous 独立，不继承请求线程的 previous）
三次 return 依次 100/0/100（与 reconcileAsync 的 [100.0,0.0,100.0] 对应）
L2 span 的 values 只有 kind=local：不出现 param/field/return 值项
后端 span 恰 4 个（controller + 3 service），requests.backendSpanCount=4；脚本无头运行时同一计数成立（允许 LOST 合法子链）
controller 不采任何 values；值只出现在 3 个 service span

requests.confidenceRule: root ui_event EXACT + controller.parentSpanId == fetch.spanId -> EXACT
requests.scriptedVariantNote: the no-header scripted run is a legal 4-span LOST chain (controller root click_lost_<spanId> + LOST_BACKEND, 3 L2 service children inheriting LOST); backendSpanCount is 4 in both variants

graph.sortRule: nodes: startNs ascending, ties by spanId; edges: parent node order then child node order
